explication: This repository is the OCPI protocol specification, not an implementation that executes a user workflow. Its product is a set of core protocol documents and independently packaged functional modules. The documented release model combines the core with optional Payments or Bookings; the tree also identifies the principal roaming domains and shared protocol references. No source excerpts were provided, so relationships beyond that documented packaging are omitted rather than inferred from filenames.
